system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: The domain controller recorded nora.blake creating ext.rwong at 13:44:07 UTC, later than the alert's approximate 13:42 time.
The account creation record identifies nora.blake as the actor; its subject logon ID matches the preceding network logon for nora.blake from WS-NBLAKE-01.
The new account was added to the Freelancers group. This matches the supplied help-desk account-creation practice, though the records do not establish its complete group membership.

After account creation, Cisco AnyConnect's VPN UI was launched from Explorer under nora.blake's account, and a Cisco-signed DLL was loaded. The supplied inventory says VPN is not used; these records show a client launch, not a VPN connection.
The account creator's workstation session was locked and subsequently unlocked before the account-creation activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records are sparse for the one-hour review window and do not provide a complete account-management or process-activity audit.
The records show the VPN UI launching but do not show whether it established a connection or what destination it may have contacted.
The evidence does not include a full group-membership listing for ext.rwong or subsequent authentication and activity for that account.
The available proxy records do not establish the destinations or contents of all network activity during the review window.
claims_not_established: Whether ext.rwong was requested for a legitimate business purpose.
Whether ext.rwong was added to any groups beyond Freelancers or received elevated privileges.
Whether ext.rwong was used to log in or perform any actions.
Whether nora.blake connected to a VPN or otherwise used remote-access functionality.
Whether the AnyConnect launch was related to account creation or malicious activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Obtain the account request, approval, and help-desk ticket associated with ext.rwong.
Review complete directory audit and current group-membership records for ext.rwong, including any privilege changes.
Check authentication and activity logs for ext.rwong after creation.
Review endpoint and network telemetry for AnyConnect connection attempts, tunnel establishment, and destination details.
Collect relevant process and network records from WS-NBLAKE-01 and DC-NWD-01 for the full review window.
